# Country scope. Read-only v10.5 Nova Elysia (Fourth Odyssey) frontier integration hook.
# Activates cleanly either when v10.5 calls oe_col2_activate_elysia_hook (setting oe_col2_elysia_frontier_hook),
# OR when a Roman host (BYZ/ROM) establishes a foothold on the North American East Coast.
oe_col2_elysia_frontier_hook_trigger = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	OR = {
		has_variable = oe_col2_elysia_frontier_hook
		AND = {
			oe_far_roman_host = yes
			any_owned_location = {
				oe_col2_in_elysia_coast = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Active ecological friction bypass via Frontier Surveyor logistics.
oe_col2_has_surveyor_bypass = {
